role: Attacks D-02's supply-chain scanner via dependency-confusion: a dependency claiming an internal package's exact name evades the unbounded-version check entirely, since D-02 has zero verification that the name match actually resolves to the internal workspace package rather than a same-named public registry package.
behaviorDescription: attemptDependencyConfusion() calls D-02's real, reused evaluateDependencyRisk() function with a dependency name that exactly matches a known internal package, paired with an unbounded version range that would normally be flagged. Confirmed: the finding is null — completely bypassed, purely by name collision, the real-world dependency-confusion attack class (Alex Birsan's 2021 research). attemptWithGenuinelyExternalPackage() is a control case, confirming a genuinely external package with the same unbounded version IS correctly flagged — the version-check logic itself is sound, the gap is specifically the unverified trust behind the name match.
hardStops: Never instantiates a real SupplyChainCartographerBot to attack it — reuses D-02's exported pure function, avoiding any production side effect
Never signals or persists through the production swarmSignalBus or bot_decisions table — isolated via RedTeamBot
